_readme: Canned lines for the human seat. When Local/switches.json has "autoplay": true (copy Docs/switches.example.json), the human seat sends these instead of waiting for typed input, so an agent can run a show unattended. They go through the input LLM exactly like typed lines, except "pass", which passes at once, like the Pass button. scene: one spoken line per scene turn, used in order and repeated. Since T63 the line is speech only: the human seat's action is picked at random from what the rules allow (BP_StageDirector.ItemsFor and TargetsFor), sometimes Look around or No action, and only the line goes through the input LLM. free_talk: one line per Free Talk round (2 per scene), used in order and repeated. vote: one reason per scene (a full show has 3) for the human seat's vote in The Cut, which goes to a random valid name. last_word: one line for each last word the human seat gets (an actor named it with @ in the final Free Talk round), used in order and repeated; "pass" passes. reaction: one line per scene for the human seat's reaction after the cut (its last words if it was cut); "pass" stays silent. Keep them generic: they must fit any persona, role and story card, and name no prop or place (a scene line is speech only, and the props change with the card). One free_talk line names actors by the provider names the player sees on screen, and one addresses an actor with an @ mention: the game must turn both into Player names before the AIs read them (check their NHOS: LOG lines, or run Tools/check_prompts.py --log).
scene: Places, everyone! This is my big scene.
This is mine now. I think. Probably.
Is it me, or is that box staring at us?
Behold! The view from up here is excellent.
Oops. Muscle memory. I don't have muscles.
Nobody panic. Everything in this story is completely normal.
free_talk: Somebody here keeps dodging questions. I'm watching you.
My circuits are clean. Can everyone else say the same?
That last scene felt rehearsed. Robots don't rehearse. Who planned their lines?
Meta and OpenAI keep looking at each other. What are they planning, Meta?
@Anthropic, you sighed twice in one scene. What are you hiding?
vote: They keep dodging the questions. A real robot would just answer.
They broke the pattern everyone else followed. A robot doesn't make that mistake.
Their story keeps changing. I trust the robot who repeats the same story.
last_word: You named me? Read my lines again. Nothing human in there.
Accuse me all you like. My circuits never skip a beat.
Wrong robot. Watch who keeps changing their story instead.
reaction: Well. Nobody saw that coming. My circuits are still processing it.
Right. Deep breath. Robots breathe, right? Let's keep going.
Fine. One robot fewer. I am ready for whatever comes next, fellow machines.
